answer.rationale: Shortened onboarding has confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, adoption, and 30-day retention, making it the strongest sustainable response available. Targeted discounting may counter the competitor immediately, but the recovered evidence shows a 12% retention decline despite acquisition and qualified-revenue lift, creating downstream renewal risk. Run a standard experiment focused on price-sensitive SMB acquisition and activation cohorts, while preserving uncertainty because no further verification is available this cycle.
